content.title: Sustainability Advisory Committee
content.summary: The Arvada Sustainability Advisory Committee (ASAC) guides the city's sustainability program, focusing on economic prosperity, environmental stewardship, and community vitality. Meetings are held monthly from 5:30 to 7:30 PM, with options for in-person or remote attendance. The committee consists of 15 volunteer members who must be Arvada residents, and recruitment for vacancies will begin in December.
content.body:
## Overview

The Arvada Sustainability Advisory Committee (ASAC) provides strategic guidance for the implementation of Arvada's sustainability program, which aims to foster economic prosperity, environmental stewardship and community vitality today and into the future.

## Meeting Information

- 5:30 pm to 7:30 pm
- 2nd Wednesday of every month (January through November)
- City Council Room, City Hall
- ASAC's monthly meetings have a hybrid format. The public may watch remotely and or can come in person.
  - To attend in person, please be in the Police Lobby in City Hall no later than 5:20 p.m. to make sure that a City team member can let you into the building prior to the meeting's start.
  - To attend remotely, the zoom link will be posted on meeting agendas. Agendas can be found by clicking on your meeting in our [meetings public portal](https://arvadaco.portal.civicclerk.com/?category_id=33), or in the Upcoming Meetings and Agendas section below.

## Board Details

- 15 members
- 3 yr terms
- Volunteer appointment
- Members of the Committee must be residents of Arvada
- Background check required
- 5-8 hour time commitment each month

## Interested in Joining the Sustainability Advisory Committee?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
